items.name: ref
items.prompt: (1) a big friendly yellow pencil with a pink eraser and a sharpened graphite tip, drawn diagonally with the tip at the bottom left and the eraser at the top right, with a small happy face on its side; (2) an open spiral sketchbook with blank cream pages; (3) a little round paint palette with dabs of tomato red, mustard, teal and ultramarine.

items.name: pencil
items.prompt: The big friendly yellow pencil from the model sheet, alone, drawn diagonally at 45 degrees with the sharpened graphite tip pointing to the bottom-left corner and the pink eraser at the top-right corner, a small happy face on its side.

items.name: palette
items.prompt: The little round paint palette from the model sheet, with dabs of tomato red, mustard, teal and ultramarine paint and a thumb hole.

items.name: bg_sketch
items.prompt: A blank page of a spiral sketchbook filling the frame: cream drawing paper with faint fibers, a row of silver spiral rings along the very top edge, faint pencil smudges near the corners, otherwise empty.

items.name: bg_kraft
items.prompt: Brown kraft cardboard with small fibre flecks, like a pinboard, a strip of pink washi tape across the top-right corner, otherwise plain.

items.name: draw.en
items.prompt: A hand-lettered cartoon title that reads exactly "Watch it draw!" (three words, nothing else), on two lines: "Watch it" above "draw!". Chunky playful letters, each in a different paper color; a little yellow pencil is drawing the exclamation mark. Spell it exactly.

items.name: draw.zh
items.prompt: 一个手绘卡通标题，文字必须准确为「一笔一笔画出来！」（七个汉字加感叹号，不要其他文字），排成一行。粗壮可爱的字体，每个字是不同颜色的剪纸，一支小黄铅笔正在画感叹号。字必须写对。
